comment: ADR-67/ADR-68 engine sources: the two repositories AISLE builds wheels from. kiss3d is absent on purpose, and so are the rapier crates the engine links: nexus's own Cargo manifest takes the published kiss3d 0.47 and rapier 0.36.0 releases from crates.io, so cargo resolves both and this file does not pin them twice.

nexus.builds: the nexus3d wheel (the GPU engine and its viewer)

rapier.builds: the rapier3d wheel (bindings/python/rapier-py-3d), the CPU engine's bindings
